note: Pool-level control for gate G-C (spec 3A): the 2% concentration cap (WS4C_MAX_PAGE_SHARE) is enforced at construction on the 9,000-pair candidate pool via benchlib.ws4c.page_cap(), counting a title in EITHER role (page_title or bridge_title), which is the conservative measurement since filters only remove pairs so a pool-level cap bounds the accepted set too. max_title_share equals cap_share exactly (12/9000), i.e. the cap is binding and saturated, not merely satisfied by chance. This neutralises the vacuous G-C FAIL recorded at n=5 accepted questions (RESULTS-WS4c.md sec 6.7): the accepted-set share is a small-sample artifact of stopping at 5, not a concentration failure of the construction. The pool itself (data/ws4c_cache/pairs.parquet) is gitignored corpus-derived data; its sha256 is recorded separately in data/MANIFEST.json under that path.
